case-333.zh-Hans:
一部电影般的30秒热带旅行vlog蒙太奇，主角是一位美丽的20岁东亚女性，深色头发，在梦幻的夏日度假中探索巴厘岛。以真实奢华旅行日记的方式拍摄，手持摄像机运动，抓拍瞬间，柔和的黄金时刻阳光，梦幻的35mm胶片美学，温暖的复古调色，浅景深，自然的皮肤质感，氛围感灯光，电影级叙事。在每个场景中保持同一位女性：深色头发、年轻外貌、自然妆容、优雅的夏日服装、放松快乐的表情。格式：4K电影级视频，24fps，35mm胶片颗粒，真实手持摄像机，柔焦，暖色调，旅行纪录片风格。

场景1（0-4秒）——抵达与村庄街道：一个温暖的巴厘岛早晨。这位女性漫步在一条狭窄的街道上，两旁是鸡蛋花树和石制神龛，她穿着亚麻裹身裙，太阳镜推到头发里。摩托车在背景中柔和模糊地驶过，香火烟雾从门口供品处飘来。摄像机从她身后跟随，然后摇到特写，她回头越过肩膀看了一眼，笑着说：“好吧，我想我已经爱上这里了。”

场景2（4-8秒）——悬崖海滩发现：她走下石阶，来到一处狭窄的悬崖海滩，绿松石色的海水在她身后的石灰岩悬崖上拍打。她赤脚走在潮线上，裙摆微微提起，海浪卷过她的脚。低角度拍摄她的脚印被泡沫填满，阳光洒在水面上，参差不齐的悬崖勾勒出地平线。

场景3（8-12秒）——稻田与丛林时刻：一个虫眼视角，透过香蕉叶和竹子向上看，阳光以温暖的光束穿透，带有柔和的镜头光晕。切到特写，她站在翠绿稻田的边缘，风吹起散落的发丝，她向外望去，轻声低语：“绿得看起来都不真实。”

场景4（12-16秒）——Warung咖啡馆与慢生活：她独自坐在一个俯瞰丛林的小型露天warung里，用纸吸管喝着新鲜椰子水。阳光透过编织的竹帘过滤进来。特写镜头拍摄她的双手捧着椰子，外壳上凝结着水珠，她满足地半笑着看树木摇曳。

场景5（16-20秒）——海洋冒险：她划着一块木制长板穿过平静的绿松石色泻湖，阳光在水面上闪烁。摄像机在水面高度环绕她，捕捉轻柔的涟漪和远处的绿色悬崖。她稍微失去平衡，大声笑起来，朝摄像机喊道：“别拍这段——算了，继续拍。”

场景6（20-24秒）——夜市探索：一个发光的巴厘岛夜市，挂满纸灯笼，沙爹烟雾袅袅升入空中，摊贩们吆喝着价格。她穿梭在人群中，品尝烤串和芒果糯米饭，她的脸被温暖的串灯和经过的摩托车前灯照亮。电影级特写拍摄她品尝时睁大的眼睛，灯笼在她身后模糊成柔和的散景。

场景7（24-27秒）——金色日落结尾：一个宽幅剪影镜头，她站在海岸线上，太阳沉入大海，天空燃烧着橙色和紫色，倒影在湿润的沙滩上荡漾。海浪轻轻冲刷她的脚踝，她把脸转向最后的光线，一只手遮住眼睛。

场景8（27-30秒）——酒店夜晚反思：一个屋顶泳池酒吧，俯瞰夜晚闪闪发光的海岸天际线。她穿着简单的白色连衣裙靠在栏杆上，头发如帘幕般在微风中飘动，城市灯光映在她的眼中。最后的亲密特写，她蜷缩在酒店床上，用一只胳膊肘撑着，直视镜头，带着柔和温暖的微笑说：“来自巴厘岛的晚安。”

摄像机风格：真实的旅行vlog摄影，手持摄像机抖动，平滑的电影级转场，缓慢推近，自然的漂移运动，偶尔的POV镜头，真实的自动对焦搜索，微妙的运动模糊。

视觉风格：梦幻的巴厘岛度假影片，精品旅行品牌美学，柔和的金色阳光，真实的皮肤质感，电影级浅景深，怀旧的35mm胶片外观，温暖的大气色调，自然无脚本的表情，情感化叙事。

避免：卡通风格、CGI外观、塑料皮肤、不真实的脸、角色外观不一致、发型变化、多余手指、扭曲的身体、人工照明、过饱和的颜色、模糊的脸、不自然的动作、重复的人。

30 秒更完整的叙事，Seedance 2.5 又将真实感提升了一个档次🎬

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

【风格】真实骑行 vlog（Authentic Cycling Vlog），运动相机 + 手机前摄 + 伴随车跟拍混剪，4K 真实摄影（Photorealistic），阴天柔光，皮肤有汗光与真实毛孔，无美颜无磨皮，竖屏 9:16

【时长】30秒

【场景】雨后山区盘山公路，路面湿滑泛着一层亮光，路侧金属护栏，远处山峦挂着流动的云雾，路边草木上挂着水珠

【角色】骑行者（女性，白色公路头盔，蓝色镜面骑行眼镜，深灰色短袖骑行服（胸前城市街景印花、拉链到底、领口下方夹着黑色运动相机遥控器）、酒红色骑行短裤（侧缝两道白色缝线）、粉色运动手表，黑色碳纤维公路车、黑色刀圈轮组）

【眼镜规则】只有全速骑行的镜头（镜头2、镜头5、镜头6）戴着眼镜；停车和自拍的镜头（镜头1、镜头3、镜头4、镜头7、镜头8）眼镜一律架在头盔前额上，整张脸和眼睛完全露出

【全局约束】全程同一套骑行服与头盔，不换装；汗量随时间递增，不可倒退；行进中双手必须都在车把或手机上，不出现第三只手；不出现其他骑行者抢镜

[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：低角度起步（Ground-level Low Angle）

贴地极低机位，画面下缘是湿漉漉的沥青路面。她单脚撑地停在路边，眼镜架在头盔前额，脸完全露出来，低头看了眼镜头笑了一下。

动作：她双手抬起把眼镜拉到眼睛上戴好，随后双手落回车把，脚扣"咔"地扣进踏板，曲柄转动，链条上链，前轮碾过一小片积水，水线甩向镜头两侧。

镜头随车轮向前轻微跟移，湿路面被轮胎压出一道深色湿痕。

音效：脚扣扣合的咔哒声、链条上链、轮胎压水的沙沙声。

[00:04-00:08] 镜头2：侧面伴随跟拍（Car-to-car Side Tracking）

正侧方伴随机位与她等速并行，全身入画。她压低上半身双手握下把，背部拉平，膝盖上下抽动，蓝色镜面眼镜戴在眼睛上。

背景的护栏和云雾山体在她身后横向快速拉过，形成速度线。

细节：额角渗出第一层汗，骑行服背部中缝出现一小块深色汗渍。

[00:08-00:12] 镜头3：路边停车自拍（Front Camera Selfie POV）

手机前置摄像头视角，画面轻微广角畸变。她已经停在路边单脚撑地，先用双手把眼镜推回头盔前额，露出整张脸和眼睛，再拿起手机举在斜前方。

动作：她冲镜头咧嘴笑，喘着气对镜头说了句什么，说话时肩膀随呼吸起伏，另一只手扶着车把稳住车，接着用举手机的那只手把镜头转向前方，扫过弯道和云雾山景，再转回自己脸上。

细节：额头和鼻尖有明显汗光，眼睛清晰可见，鬓角碎发被汗黏在脸上，风把耳边的碎发往后吹。画面有真实手持抖动和风噪爆音。

[00:12-00:16] 镜头4：360全景环绕（360 Action Cam / Invisible Selfie Stick）

模仿360全景运动相机效果，轻微鱼眼畸变，自拍杆被完全抹除。她仍在路边停着，双脚撑地跨在车上，眼镜架在头盔前额。镜头悬在她斜上方约一米处，围着她和车缓慢转一整圈。

画面依次转过：她的正脸和头盔顶、身后的湿路面和护栏、车尾和后轮、路侧的云雾山谷、再回到正脸。

动作：转到正脸时她抬头看镜头，笑着抬手做了个"往前走"的手势，另一只手扶着车把。

细节：手臂皮肤上有细密汗珠，手表带内侧一圈汗渍。

[00:16-00:20] 镜头5：爬坡喘息特写（Handheld Close-up / Uphill）

侧面近景，只拍她的脸和肩膀，背景是缓慢后退的山体和护栏。坡度明显，她重新戴上了眼镜，踩踏频率变慢变重。

动作：她咬着牙站起来摇车，双手死死握住车把，上半身左右摆动，嘴张开大口吸气，颈侧血管随呼吸起伏。一滴汗从太阳穴滑到下颌，被风甩飞。

细节：整件骑行服前胸和后背已经湿透变成深色，紧贴身体，头盔带上有一圈汗渍，镜面眼镜下缘起了一层薄雾。

[00:20-00:23] 镜头6：下坡第一视角（Handlebar POV / First-person）

车把固定机位，第一人称视角。画面能看到黑色车把、缠着的把带、码表屏幕和她握把的双手。

动作：车头快速冲下弯道，视线随身体压弯向左倾斜，路侧护栏和树木在画面两侧飞速掠过，前轮压过一小段积水溅起水花。她的手指按下刹车把，速度略降后再次放开。

风噪骤然放大，画面因高速产生轻微抖动和边缘模糊。

[00:23-00:27] 镜头7：终点擦汗（Static Medium Shot）

固定机位中景。她把车靠在护栏上，跨下车，摘下头盔单手拎着，眼镜随头盔一起摘下来挂在手指上，另一只手把汗湿的刘海往后一捋，头发湿成一缕缕黏在额头上。

动作：她放下头盔，双手拿起水壶仰头灌了一大口，水从嘴角流下脖子，用手背抹了一下下巴，然后长长呼出一口气，肩膀垮下来。

细节：脱头盔后头顶有明显压痕，脸颊通红发亮，眼睛周围有被眼镜压出的浅印，颈侧和锁骨有汗流下来的亮线。

[00:27-00:30] 镜头8：收尾比耶（Low Angle Pull-back）

低角度仰拍，她重新戴回头盔，眼镜架在头盔前额，整张脸露出来。她站在车旁，一只手扶着车座，另一只手举到脸侧比耶，冲镜头笑，还带着喘。身后是整片流动的云雾山谷和湿亮的盘山公路。

镜头缓缓向后下方拉远，人和车缩到画面下三分之一，山雾在她身后慢慢向上翻涌。

音效：全程链条声、变速器咔哒声、轮胎压水声、真实的粗重呼吸声与风噪，背景无音乐，最后两秒只留下风声和喘息声。

It really looks exactly like the real thing 😄

A more complete 30-second narrative, and Seedance 2.5 has raised the realism another level 🎬

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

[Style] Authentic Cycling Vlog, mixed edit of action camera + phone front camera + accompanying car tracking shots, 4K photorealistic, soft overcast light, skin with sweat sheen and real pores, no beauty filter and no skin smoothing, vertical 9:16

[Duration] 30 seconds

[Scene] A rainy mountain winding road, the road surface wet and slippery with a layer of shine, metal guardrails along the roadside, distant mountains draped in flowing clouds and mist, water droplets hanging on the roadside vegetation

[Character] Cyclist (female, white road helmet, blue mirrored cycling glasses, dark gray short-sleeve cycling jersey (city street scene print on the chest, zipper all the way down, black action camera remote clipped below the collar), burgundy cycling shorts (two white seams on the side), pink sports watch, black carbon fiber road bike, black deep-section wheelset)

[Glasses rule] Only the full-speed riding shots (Shot 2, Shot 5, Shot 6) have the glasses on; in the stopped and selfie shots (Shot 1, Shot 3, Shot 4, Shot 7, Shot 8), the glasses are always resting on the front of the helmet, with the whole face and eyes fully exposed

[Global constraints] The same cycling outfit and helmet throughout, no costume changes; sweat amount increases over time and cannot go backward; while moving, both hands must be on the handlebars or the phone, no third hand appears; no other cyclists stealing the frame

[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Ground-level Low Angle start

Extremely low ground-level camera, the lower edge of the frame is wet asphalt road. She stops at the roadside with one foot on the ground, glasses resting on the front of the helmet, face fully exposed, looks down at the camera and smiles.

Action: She raises both hands to pull the glasses down onto her eyes and put them on properly, then both hands return to the handlebars, her foot clips "click" into the pedal, the crank turns, the chain engages, the front wheel rolls over a small puddle, and water lines splash to both sides of the frame.

The camera follows slightly forward with the wheel, and the wet road is pressed into a dark wet track by the tires.

Sound effects: the click of the cleat engaging, the chain engaging, the rustle of tires pressing through water.

[00:04-00:08] Shot 2: Car-to-car Side Tracking

A direct side accompanying camera moving parallel at the same speed, full body in frame. She lowers her upper body and grips the drops with both hands, back flat, knees pumping up and down, blue mirrored glasses on her eyes.

Background guardrails and cloud-mist mountains quickly slide horizontally behind her, forming speed lines.

Details: The first layer of sweat seeps out at her temples, and a small dark sweat patch appears along the center seam of the back of the cycling jersey.

[00:08-00:12] Shot 3: Roadside stop selfie (Front Camera Selfie POV)

Phone front camera perspective, slight wide-angle distortion in the frame. She has already stopped at the roadside with one foot on the ground. First she uses both hands to push the glasses back onto the front of the helmet, revealing her whole face and eyes, then picks up the phone and holds it diagonally in front of her.

Action: She grins at the camera, panting, says something to the camera, her shoulders rising and falling with her breathing while speaking, her other hand holding the handlebar to steady the bike, then with the hand holding the phone she turns the camera toward the front, sweeping across the bend and the cloud-mist mountain view, then turns it back to her face.

Details: Obvious sweat shine on her forehead and nose tip, eyes clearly visible, stray hairs at the temples stuck to her face by sweat, wind blowing the stray hairs by her ears backward. The frame has real handheld shake and wind-noise clipping.

[00:12-00:16] Shot 4: 360 panoramic orbit (360 Action Cam / Invisible Selfie Stick)

Imitating a 360 panoramic action camera effect, slight fisheye distortion, the selfie stick completely erased. She is still stopped at the roadside, both feet on the ground straddling the bike, glasses resting on the front of the helmet. The camera hovers about one meter diagonally above her, slowly circling her and the bike for a full revolution.

The frame passes in sequence: her front face and the top of the helmet, the wet road and guardrails behind her, the rear of the bike and rear wheel, the cloud-mist valley on the roadside, then back to her front face.

Action: When the camera comes around to her front face, she looks up at the camera, smiles and raises a hand to make a "go forward" gesture, her other hand holding the handlebar.

Details: Fine beads of sweat on the skin of her arms, a ring of sweat stains on the inside of the watch strap.

[00:16-00:20] Shot 5: Uphill panting close-up (Handheld Close-up / Uphill)

Side close-up, only her face and shoulders, background is slowly receding mountains and guardrails. The slope is obvious, she has put the glasses back on, and her pedaling cadence becomes slower and heavier.

Action: She grits her teeth and stands up to rock the bike, both hands gripping the handlebars hard, upper body swaying left and right, mouth open taking big gulps of air, neck veins rising and falling with her breathing. A drop of sweat slides from her temple to her jaw and is flung away by the wind.

Details: The entire front chest and back of the cycling jersey are already soaked through and turned dark, clinging to her body, a ring of sweat stains on the helmet strap, and a thin layer of fog on the lower edge of the mirrored glasses.

[00:20-00:23] Shot 6: Downhill first-person view (Handlebar POV / First-person)

Handlebar fixed camera, first-person perspective. The frame shows the black handlebar, wrapped bar tape, the cycle computer screen, and her hands gripping the bars.

Action: The front of the bike rushes quickly down the bend, the view tilts left as her body leans into the turn, roadside guardrails and trees flash past on both sides of the frame, the front wheel rolls through a small puddle and splashes water. Her fingers press the brake lever, speed drops slightly, then release again.

Wind noise suddenly amplifies, and the frame has slight shake and edge blur due to high speed.

[00:23-00:27] Shot 7: Finish line wiping sweat (Static Medium Shot)

Fixed-camera medium shot. She leans the bike against the guardrail, gets off, takes off the helmet and carries it in one hand, the glasses come off with the helmet and hang from her fingers, and with the other hand she pushes her sweat-soaked bangs back, hair wet and stuck to her forehead in strands.

Action: She puts down the helmet, picks up the water bottle with both hands, tilts her head back and takes a big gulp, water runs from the corner of her mouth down her neck, she wipes her chin with the back of her hand, then lets out a long exhale and her shoulders slump.

Details: After taking off the helmet there are obvious pressure marks on top of her head, her cheeks are red and shiny, there are faint marks around her eyes pressed by the glasses, and bright lines of sweat running down the sides of her neck and collarbone.

[00:27-00:30] Shot 8: Ending peace sign (Low Angle Pull-back)

Low-angle upward shot, she puts the helmet back on, glasses resting on the front of the helmet, whole face exposed. She stands beside the bike, one hand on the saddle, the other raised to the side of her face making a peace sign, smiling at the camera, still panting. Behind her is the whole flowing cloud-mist valley and the wet shiny winding mountain road.

The camera slowly pulls back and down, the person and bike shrink to the lower third of the frame, and the mountain mist slowly churns upward behind her.

Sound effects: chain sound, derailleur clicks, tires pressing through water, real heavy breathing and wind noise throughout, no background music, and in the last two seconds only wind and panting remain.

extra-1c1c2a2cf8d6.zh-Hans:
创作一段15秒的搞笑动画序列，采用与所提供分镜完全相同的温暖、优雅的3D卡通/皮克斯风格。保持相同的丈夫和妻子角色设计、豪华的奶油色卧室和洗衣房、电影感暖光、富有表现力的夸张面部反应以及流畅的喜剧节奏。
场景1——0–3秒：丈夫正躺在床上放松地看书。突然，他注意到妻子的胸罩和上衣从另一个房间被扔到地板上。他慢慢放下书，瞪大眼睛、满脸狐疑地盯着它们。在他的想象中，这显然像是妻子正在准备与里面的某个人共度浪漫时刻。
场景2——3–6秒：丈夫立刻兴奋地跳起来，冲到镜子前。他喷口气清新剂、喷香水、整理头发，并给自己一个自信、诱惑的微笑。他确信有浪漫的事情正在发生，他应该赶快加入妻子。
场景3——6–9秒：他看起来英俊自信，缓慢而戏剧性地打开门，期待着一个浪漫的惊喜。他的表情突然从兴奋变成完全的困惑。
场景4——9–12秒：揭示真相：他的妻子只是在洗衣服。她正从洗衣机里一件一件地拿出刚洗好的衣服扔到地板上，因为她需要帮忙搬。她看着站在那里、穿戴整齐、满身香水味的丈夫。
场景5——12–15秒：妻子立刻利用他，一脸无辜地笑着把一大堆湿衣服堆到他怀里。丈夫完全被困在衣服山下面。他的浪漫兴奋瞬间消失，带着悲伤、郁闷、挫败的表情慢慢走开，而妻子则开心地继续洗衣服。
喜剧风格：夸张的面部表情、快速建立的误会、戏剧性的揭示、视觉幽默、流畅的角色动画、电影感构图、温暖的豪华室内、全程保持相同的角色一致性和视觉风格。
